description: Python preprocess_sequence outputs for synthetic long-format sequences built with the test suite's fixture logic; written by scripts/export_web.py.
float_encoding: float32 arrays are written as the shortest decimal that rounds to the same float32; raw input coordinates are exact float64 values (rounded to 6 decimals when generated); null is NaN

cases.name: right_only_longer
cases.description: Right hand only for 45 frames, downsampled to 32.

cases.name: both_hands_tie_shorter
cases.description: Both hands in all 12 frames: a presence tie, so no mirroring (ties go to the right hand); upsampled to 32.

cases.name: left_only_mirrored
cases.description: Left hand only: mirrored to the right.

cases.name: left_dominant_both_hands
cases.description: Both hands, right hand missing in frames 5-16 (left 36 vs right 24 frames): mirrored, hand blocks, pose pairs and presence columns swapped.

cases.name: tie_with_edge_gaps
cases.description: Left hand in frames 0-19, right hand in frames 10-29: a 20-20 tie, not mirrored; each hand is NaN (then 0) outside its own span, without extrapolation.

cases.name: pose_nan_hand_fallback
cases.description: Pose NaN in every frame: no shoulders, so the hands' bounding box normalises.

cases.name: pose_rows_absent_mirrored_fallback
cases.description: No pose rows at all and only the left hand: mirrored, hand_fallback normalisation.

cases.name: hand_less_frames_dropped
cases.description: Right hand missing in frames 12-18: those frames are dropped before resampling (t_raw 40, t_kept 33).

cases.name: partial_hand_landmarks
cases.description: Right hand has 5 NaN landmarks in frames 8-13 and the left hand 1 in frames 20-27: those hands count as absent there, but their finite points are kept and resampled.

cases.name: fixture_partial_hands
cases.description: The fixture's partial_hands case: no left hand, right hand missing in the first third of the frames.

cases.name: shoulders_partly_missing
cases.description: Left shoulder NaN in frames 0-5, right shoulder in frames 24-29 and both shoulder y values in frames 10-11: medians use only finite values, per axis.

cases.name: one_shoulder_never_visible
cases.description: Right shoulder NaN in every frame: no frame has both shoulders, so hand_fallback.

cases.name: exactly_min_hand_frames
cases.description: A hand in exactly 3 frames (the minimum): kept and upsampled from 3 to 32 frames.

cases.name: excluded_insufficient_hand_frames
cases.description: A hand in only 2 frames: excluded as insufficient_hand_frames.

cases.name: excluded_degenerate_shoulders
cases.description: Both shoulders at the same point: shoulder distance 0, excluded as degenerate_scale.

cases.name: excluded_degenerate_hand_fallback
cases.description: No pose and every hand point at one position: zero hand spread, excluded as degenerate_scale under hand_fallback.

cases.name: face_rows_shuffled_frame_gaps
cases.description: Includes face rows (dropped), rows in random order and non-consecutive frame numbers; left 8 vs right 6 frames, so mirrored.

cases.name: coordinates_outside_unit_square
cases.description: Hand x beyond 1.0 and wrist y below 0.0, as when a hand leaves the frame: such values are used as they are.
